_about: Commands for the ABApp shortcut. Each command has a label (its button on the Home tab) and steps run in order. A step is {"notify": {title, body}} or {"request": {url, secret?}}; request does a GET of url, replacing {secret} with the named key from the shortcut's Secrets dictionary. Commands starting with _ are hidden from the Home tab.

notify.title: ABApp 🌱
notify.body: Test ran: fetched a page and showed this notification.
